user.title: Connect AVARMA via Modbus
user.description: RS485 gateway on Comm 3 of the heat pump (9600 8N1). Modbus TCP: gateway in Modbus TCP gateway mode. RTU over TCP: gateway in transparent mode.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the gateway
data_description.slave: Modbus address of the heat pump, factory default 1

error.cannot_connect: Gateway not reachable or no answer from the heat pump
error.invalid_response: The heat pump rejected the request. Check slave ID and protocol.

abort.already_configured: This heat pump is already configured

data_description.scan_interval: Installer parameters are read every 10 minutes regardless.
